_readme: Maps Teltonika FMC150 (wired CAN tracker) AVL I/O element IDs → PREDICT sensor types.
Per-model file: the bridge picks avl_map.<model>.json by the IMEI→model mapping in BRIDGE_DEVICES (see fmc_bridge.py). Sibling file: avl_map.fmc001.json.
The bridge publishes value = raw * scale + offset.

kind 'sensor' → payload.sensors[sensor_type]; kind 'meta' → top-level payload field (e.g. ignition, vin); kind 'dtc' → published to teltonika/{imei}/dtc; kind 'event' → published to teltonika/{imei}/event (eco-driving).
encoding 'ascii' → variable-length (8E X-group) bytes are decoded as ASCII instead of hex (needed for AVL 325 VIN and AVL 282 fault codes).

AVL IDs follow the Teltonika wiki page 'FMC150 Teltonika Data Sending Parameters ID' (CAN I/O standard + extended elements). CAN parameters only arrive if the vehicle is on Teltonika's compatibility list and the correct CAN program number is selected in the Configurator.

sensor_type strings match the FMC001 map wherever the physical quantity is the same (engine_rpm, coolant_temperature, fuel_level, ...) so rules and the dashboard stay device-agnostic. MUST stay in sync with backend/app/services/provisioning.py (FMC150_SENSOR_CATALOG) and backend/app/db/init_db.py (SEED_RULES).
ID 16 (GNSS Total Odometer) is deliberately NOT mapped here: ID 87 is the true CAN mileage and both would write the same sensor_type in one record.
Discovery tool: the bridge logs every UNMAPPED AVL ID it receives (check `docker compose logs -f bridge`) so you can see exactly what your car sends and adjust here — NO code changes needed.

io_elements.name: Ignition
io_elements._comment: 0/1 — top-level 'ignition' flag, drives GREY→GREEN

io_elements.name: Movement
io_elements._comment: 0/1 — top-level 'movement' flag

io_elements.name: GSM Signal
io_elements._comment: Teltonika standard

io_elements.name: Battery Voltage
io_elements._comment: External (vehicle) voltage from the wired power connection, sent in mV → V

io_elements.name: Tracker Battery Voltage
io_elements._comment: FMC150 internal backup battery, mV → V

io_elements.name: Vehicle Speed
io_elements._comment: Teltonika standard (GNSS-based speed also in gps block)

io_elements.name: Engine RPM
io_elements._comment: CAN standard — 'Engine Speed'

io_elements.name: Coolant Temperature
io_elements._comment: CAN standard — signed, multiplier 0.1 (raw 910 = 91.0 °C)

io_elements.name: Vehicle Speed (CAN)
io_elements._comment: CAN standard — wheel-speed/ECU speed; same sensor_type as FMC001's OBD speed (37) so rules match both

io_elements.name: Throttle Position
io_elements._comment: CAN standard

io_elements.name: Fuel Level
io_elements._comment: CAN standard — percent. NOTE: AVL 81 is vehicle speed, not fuel

io_elements.name: Fuel Level (liters)
io_elements._comment: CAN standard — absolute fuel amount

io_elements.name: Fuel Consumed (total)
io_elements._comment: CAN standard — cumulative since first engine operation

io_elements.name: Odometer
io_elements._comment: CAN standard 'Total Mileage', sent in m → km. Preferred over GNSS odometer (16, unmapped on purpose)

io_elements.name: Engine Total Hours
io_elements._comment: CAN standard — engine work time in minutes

io_elements.name: Vehicle Battery Voltage (CAN)
io_elements._comment: CAN standard — battery voltage as reported by the vehicle itself (66 is the tracker's own supply reading)

io_elements.name: HV Battery Charge Level
io_elements._comment: CAN standard — EV/hybrid high-voltage battery charge

io_elements.name: Ambient Air Temperature
io_elements._comment: CAN extended — signed

io_elements.name: Engine Oil Temperature
io_elements._comment: CAN extended — signed

io_elements.name: Engine Oil Pressure
io_elements._comment: CAN extended

io_elements.name: Engine Oil Level
io_elements._comment: CAN extended

io_elements.name: VIN
io_elements._comment: 17-char ASCII VIN via 8E X-group — top-level payload field, not a dashboard sensor

io_elements.name: DTC Count
io_elements._comment: Number of active diagnostic trouble codes (CAN adapter group)

io_elements.name: Fault Codes
io_elements._comment: Comma-separated ASCII codes via 8E X-group (LV-CAN200+DTC / CANCONTROL) — bridge splits and publishes each to teltonika/{imei}/dtc

io_elements.name: Distance Until Service
io_elements._comment: CAN standard 'Distance till next servicing' — countdown to next scheduled service; only if the car exposes it

io_elements.name: Remaining Distance
io_elements._comment: CAN standard — range with current tank/battery

io_elements.name: Green Driving Type
io_elements._comment: 1=harsh accel, 2=harsh brake, 3=harsh corner — enable Eco driving in Configurator

io_elements.name: Green Driving Value
io_elements._comment: Magnitude paired with AVL 253

io_elements.name: Overspeeding
io_elements._comment: Device overspeeding event — enable Overspeeding in Configurator
